root_cause: Sibling order was the widget child order; SemanticState had no ordinal sort key and the pass never reordered siblings.
change: crates/incular-semantics/src/lib.rs (OrdinalSortKey, SemanticState::sort_key); crates/incular-widgets/src/semantics.rs (Semantics::sort_key); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/semantics.rs (sort_sibling_groups/sort_sibling_group in apply_semantics: compatible-key runs sorted stably by order, unkeyed runs kept)
api_change: new OrdinalSortKey type and Semantics::sort_key builder; SemanticState gains a field
limitations: A key change on a live widget re-sorts through the existing Subtree mark (DescendantContent reaches the owning parent); no test covers a live key update.
note: Previously deferred for needing a parent re-mark in reconciliation; the existing Subtree mark already supplies it, so no reconciliation edit was needed.

root_cause: No ShowOnScreen action kind existed and no path revealed a node in its viewport.
change: crates/incular-semantics/src/lib.rs (SemanticActionKind/SemanticAction::ShowOnScreen); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/semantics.rs (advertised on nodes with a Scroll/SliverViewport ancestor; semantic_show_on_screen moves the nearest viewport via controller.jump_to); crates/incular-runtime/src/frame.rs (dispatch arm); crates/incular-accessibility/src/lib.rs (maps to AccessKit ScrollIntoView both ways)
api_change: new enum variants: exhaustive matches downstream need an arm
limitations: AccessKit ScrollIntoView translation has no unit test. Reveal uses semantic world bounds and assumes unit scale. Jump is immediate, not animated.

root_cause: Semantics had no container or explicitChildNodes flag; a bare annotation produced no node and merging took every descendant.
change: crates/incular-semantics/src/lib.rs (SemanticState::container, explicit_child_nodes); crates/incular-widgets/src/semantics.rs (builders; explicit() treats a non-default state as metadata so container(true) yields a GenericContainer node); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/semantics.rs (keeps_explicit_child_nodes: a merging element with explicitChildNodes keeps children as nodes and gathers only its own label)
api_change: two new builders; no existing signature changed
limitations: Container is not a merge boundary: a container under a MergeSemantics ancestor is still merged into it. explicit_child_nodes only has an effect on a merging element.

root_cause: AccessKit 0.24 has no property for an adjustable node's next increment or decrement value, so the desktop tree cannot carry increasedValue/decreasedValue.
change: No change this pass. The mobile projection already carries the full SemanticNode, so the values reach mobile without a change.
limitations: Desktop (AccessKit) projection blocked on the library. Mobile emits StateChanged, not a dedicated value event, when only these values change.

root_cause: Opacity exposed the child's semantics at any alpha, and no always-include flag existed.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/specs.rs and tree/widget/constructors.rs (SemanticProperties::always_include_semantics, Widget::always_include_semantics); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/semantics.rs (semantics_hidden drops a zero-alpha Opacity, rounded on the 0..255 scale, unless flagged); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs (a controlled opacity whose alpha changes marks Subtree); builders in tree/descriptors.rs (Opacity, FadeTransition), implicit_animations.rs (AnimatedOpacity), scrolling/sliver_descriptors.rs (SliverOpacity)
tests: crates/incular-widgets/tests/clip_opacity.rs::opacity_zero_stays_hittable_and_hides_semantics_unless_included (updated: old assertion encoded the paint-only design)
api_change: Opacity no longer exposes a zero-alpha child's semantics by default; callers needing it must call always_include_semantics(true)
limitations: SliverAnimatedOpacity and SliverFadeTransition in scrolling/sliver_fade.rs have no flag. Animating a controlled opacity re-collects its subtree on each changed frame.
note: Shared files touched: specs.rs, constructors.rs, interaction.rs, descriptors.rs, implicit_animations.rs, sliver_descriptors.rs, clip_opacity.rs, tree_layout_painting.rs.

root_cause: The semantics pass keys every collected node by ElementId; per-region CustomPaint nodes have no element.
api_change: would need a public painter method returning semantic regions
limitations: Needs a painter-level API, synthetic node support in the incremental pass, and a harness scene. Wrap painted parts in Semantics meanwhile.
note: Deferred with reason, as the brief allows.
